messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

It’s been on the gravel pad behind my place. A little notice for pickup would be helpful; I’d prefer it not come back here afterward, though I rent and haven’t checked with my landlord about changing the arrangement.
I need it for hauling on my home project within the next few weeks; I don’t have exact dates yet. I’m open to storing it elsewhere if that works, but I can’t just wait until A is done using it.

I want to take the trailer on weekend trips in the next few weeks, but I don’t have specific dates to prioritize. I’m open to giving notice before pickup and sharing hauling duties; I want enough flexibility to plan my trips. I don’t know B’s situation.

Forty-eight hours’ notice and an agreed handoff work. I can’t agree to alternating open-ended turns; we need to reserve specific date ranges so I can use it within the next few weeks. I’ll check whether my place could work for storage, but can’t offer it as a backup yet.

Mostly. The shared booking list and 48 hours’ notice work, but I’d rather keep bookings first come, first served than alternate turns—I need flexibility for weekend trips. I can’t commit to storing it at my place as a backup.

That sounds helpful, and 48 hours’ notice should be fine. I’d prefer it not return to my pad after use; I still need to check with my landlord about changing the arrangement, so it would help if you look into storage elsewhere.
Yes. I can book specific date ranges first come, first served, with 48 hours’ notice to B and an agreed handoff spot. I can’t offer storage at my place.
I don’t have exact date ranges yet, so I can’t claim any today. My project still needs the trailer within the next few weeks; I can’t just wait until A has booked his weekends.
Weekdays can work for my project, as long as I can book the dates I need within the next few weeks and A’s weekend bookings don’t push it later. I’m fine with 48 hours’ notice and an agreed handoff.
I don’t have specific weekend dates to post yet. My trips are in the next few weeks, and I need to keep the dates flexible.
Yes, that sounds fine for now. I’d be glad if it didn’t return to my pad, and I’ll check with my landlord about the change. 48 hours’ notice works for me.

The booking split, notice, and handoff work. Storage isn’t settled until I check whether my place works, and I still can’t post exact dates yet. I’ll send weekday ranges once I pin them down; I need a slot within the next few weeks.
